acceptance: CONTRIBUTING.md on the published-results branch links to https://benchbox.dev/docs/contributing-results.html (no 404 link to develop/docs/contributing-results.md) and uses BenchBox-dev/benchbox repository URLs.
context: Verified on 2026-11-24: origin/published-results:CONTRIBUTING.md line 13 links to https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/blob/develop/docs/contributing-results.md, which returns 404 after user docs moved to BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site. Lines 5 and 7 also still use joeharris76/BenchBox.
description:
## Problem
`CONTRIBUTING.md` on the public `published-results` branch links to `https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/blob/develop/docs/contributing-results.md` (line 13), which returns 404 since user documentation moved to `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site`, and still uses the old `joeharris76/BenchBox` repository URLs (lines 5 and 7).

## Change
Open a PR against `published-results` updating `CONTRIBUTING.md` to link to `https://benchbox.dev/docs/contributing-results.html` and `BenchBox-dev/benchbox`, then remove the live-broken-link note from `docs/internal/adr/adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md`.
